gazette_location.description_raw_en: An extension to the existing YUEN LONG TAI YUK ROAD (which was gazetted vide G.N. 2944/77) running in a southerly direction for about 162 metres where it terminates at its junction with MA TIN ROAD as shown coloured pink and cross-hatched black on Plan No. LD/YL/R9.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此路為憲示第二九四四／七七號所公告之元朗體育路之延展部份，向南伸展約一百六十二米，至與馬田路交界處終止。在LD/YL/R9號圖則上以粉紅色間以交錯黑斜線標明。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: An extension to the existing MA TIN ROAD (which was gazetted vide G.N. 2481/78) running in a southerly direction for about 77 metres and then turns smoothly to run in a west south-westerly direction for about 577 metres where it terminates at its junction with an unformed road as shown coloured pink and hatched black on Plan No. LD/YL/R9.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此路為憲示第二四八一／七八號所公告之馬田路之延展部份，向南伸展約七十七米，然後順轉向西南偏西伸展約五百七十七米，至與一未建成街道交界處終止。在LD/YL/R9號圖則上以粉紅色間以黑斜線標明。
